newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 29.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's Daily Variety:
* Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Inc said it would acquire Metromedia's entertainment group -- Orion Pictures, Samuel Goldwyn Co and MPCA -- for $573 million in cash.
* News Corp Chairman Rupert Murdoch's satellite-TV joint venture with EchoStar Communications is in doubt, EchoStar said Monday.
* Imagine Entertainment is in serious talks to acquire the Steve Martin script "Bofinger," with Martin planning to star in the comedy for director Frank Oz, sources said.
* Walt Disney unit ABC's the three-part mini-series on Stephen King's "The Shining," had a disappointing start as News Corp's Fox and Westinghouse's CBS prospered.
* The Return of the Jedi was relaunched last weekend, generating $8.9 million at the box office. Liar Liar galvanized Italy and Anaconda was released into Hong Kong and Puerto Rico.
* Paxson who has built a string of UHF infomercial stations in major markets, has bid $250 million for WBIS, the troubled New York City station co-owned by Dow Jones and ITT Corp, sources said.
* Only a year and a half after Sandy Climan left Creative Artists Agency to join former boss Ron Meyer at Universal Studios Inc as an executive vice president, he plans to return to Creative Artists.
